quote.text: The invulnerable is not that which is never struck, but that which is never wounded.
quote.author: Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • True resilience in parenthood means understanding that no child is perfect—it's through overcoming setbacks together that lasting strength is built.
    • When challenges arise, support and nurture rather than shield completely; instill wisdom so young hearts learn how to heal and grow even when life strikes hard.
  • Leadership
    • Effective leadership is not defined by an absence of difficulties but by the capacity to guide a team through them unscathed in spirit.
    • Embrace criticism and conflict as opportunities for growth, ensuring that your inner resolve and clarity remain untarnished by external turmoil.
  • Product Management
    • In product management, setbacks and unexpected challenges are inevitable; your strength lies in your ability to adapt and refine your vision without being derailed.
    • Build a team culture that sees every failure as a chance to improve, ensuring that the core essence of the product remains untouched even as external conditions change.
